in_marathi.name: Ekanath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of One God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekanath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Eka meaning one, and Ishwara meaning God, Ekanath represents the one who is devoted to one God. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology, particularly for those who seek to focus on a single deity in their spiritual practice.
